author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam Savage visits the @NationalGalleryofArtUS in Washington, D.C., to get an up-close look at the only Leonardo da Vinci painting on public display in the Americas: the extraordinary portrait of 16-year-old Ginevra de' Benci. Alongside curator and head of Italian and Spanish paintings Eve Straussman-Pflanzer, Adam inspects the incredible brushwork, visible fingerprints and mysterious emblem painted on the back of the panel, and learns about the odd circumstances that led to this 550-year-old portrait as well as its clandestine journey to Washington, D.C. via ... unusual means. What do YOU think Ginevra's facial expression is communicating?
